task.description: WF-03 Step 3b: SECURITY-REVIEWER gate on ISS-0724's implementation (tenant-data path, exam session persistence).
acceptance_criteria: INV-1 tenant isolation preserved across the split write calls
No behavior/content change to persisted rows
No new leakage risk from splitting one write loop into two

result.summary: INV-1 (tenant isolation): prefix threaded unchanged through persist_session_questions/5 -> both write_question_rows/4 calls -> write_record('session_question', attrs, actor_id, prefix), identical to pre-refactor single-loop call; one prefix bound once, no possibility of the two blocks landing in different schemas. INV-2/3/5 not applicable (pre-S4/S5). INV-4/INV-7 not applicable (no secrets, no raw SQL). INV-8: with-chain propagates {:error, reason} from either write_question_rows/4 call, same error handling as before, no new bare pattern matches. Behavioral equivalence confirmed: sort_order bit-identical (random block keeps resolver-assigned sort_order, manual block via Enum.with_index(length(resolved_random)) is provably equivalent to the old reindex), attrs shape unchanged, actor_id/candidate_id attribution unchanged. No leakage risk from splitting the loop -- both calls share the same session_id/actor_id/prefix bound once in the enclosing frame. Verdict: PASS, no BLOCKER findings, pure structural refactor.
